annotations.kubernetes.io/limit-ranger: LimitRanger plugin set: cpu, memory request for init container bootstrap-consumer; cpu, memory limit for init container bootstrap-consumer

args:
set -e
echo "[init] Bootstrapping config and code..."

# /config is a RWX PVC (writable). Ensure permissions.
mkdir -p /config
chown -R 1000:1000 /config
chmod -R u+w /config

# Seed config files only if missing
if [ ! -f /config/pipeline-configmap.yaml ]; then
  echo "[init] Seeding pipeline-configmap.yaml from /defaults"
  cp /defaults/pipeline-configmap.yaml /config/pipeline-configmap.yaml
  chmod 644 /config/pipeline-configmap.yaml
fi



# Copy code into RWX CephFS once (keeps your existing workflow)
if [ ! -f /app/consumer-merge-data/.code_initialized ]; then
  cp -r /code/* /app/consumer-merge-data/
  touch /app/consumer-merge-data/.code_initialized
fi
chown -R 1000:1000 /app/consumer-merge-data
chmod -R u+w /app/consumer-merge-data
initContainers.name: bootstrap-consumer

annotations.kubernetes.io/limit-ranger: LimitRanger plugin set: cpu, memory request for init container bootstrap-producer; cpu, memory limit for init container bootstrap-producer

args:
set -e
mkdir -p ./logs
echo "[main] Pod: ${POD_NAME}"
echo "[main] Using config: ${PIPELINE_CONFIG}"
ls -l /config || true
head -n 40 "${PIPELINE_CONFIG}" || true

chmod +x ./run.sh

# Do NOT start yet. You will start via your script across pods.
echo "[main] Ready. Waiting for manual start..."
tail -f /dev/null
containers.name: producer-container
